name: @mixar/style-generator
description: Generates Mixar's Dart and CSS colour tokens from the DTCG sources in tokens/.

scripts.check: tsc -p . && npm run generate && git diff --exit-code -- :/apps/gui-flutter/lib/core/theme/mixar_palette.dart :/apps/gui-flutter/lib/core/theme/mixar_colors.dart :/apps/website/src/styles/tokens.css
